1_is_canonical_S_displacement.verdict: YES (Kinematically & Numerically in Initial Baseline State)
1_is_canonical_S_displacement.rationale: Under initial generative beliefs (A=I, b=0), the predicted state p_pred is identically p_0. Consequently, ActiveInferenceEngine.step(p_0, p_T) computes ||p_0 - p_T||_2, which is mathematically identical to Euclidean state displacement Delta_p = ||p_T - p_0||_2.

2_is_canonical_S_prediction_error.rationale: In S4 and Layer 4 Active Inference, surprise is architecturally formalized as generative prediction error Free Energy against the transition model q_hat = A p + b. The fact that it degenerates to displacement is an artifact of the static persistence prior (A=I, b=0).

3_is_p0_actual_prediction_target.rationale: In single-turn evaluations from resting baseline with unadapted beliefs, p_0 is the exact prediction target because the unadapted prior assumes identity persistence: p_hat = p_0.

4_is_A_p0_plus_b_actual_S4_predicted_sta.rationale: Verified in src/core/orchestrator/cognitive_orchestrator.py:L335-341 and src/core/inference/active_inference.py:L120: predicted = self._A @ p + self._b.

5_do_quantities_have_equivalent_or_diffe.rationale: State displacement Delta_p = p_T - p_0 measures physical limbic trajectory change (a bodily dynamical state). Prediction residual r_T = p_T - (A p_0 + b) measures generative model expectation failure (an epistemic state). When beliefs adapt online (A != I or b != 0), r_T structurally diverges from Delta_p.

rq5_representation_hierarchy.name: Canonical Scalar Surprise
rq5_representation_hierarchy.tier_separability: Fails Gate 2 dual criteria (Delta_ML >= 0.10, Delta_HM >= 0.15) for all conversational T <= 25. At T=12, Delta_HM is compressed to +0.0216 due to isotropic radial collision.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.information_retained: 1D scalar distance only; 0% directional or component-specific information retained.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.collapse_behavior: Severely vulnerable to scalar collapse: 1,600+ Med-High collapse pairs (|diff_S| <= 0.02) at T=12, hiding average angular divergences of ~50 degrees.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.robustness_across_T: Smooth, monotonically increasing magnitude across T, but chronically compressed in Delta_HM.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.sensitivity_to_baseline: High: anchored strictly to Euclidean distance from resting attractor p_0.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.sensitivity_to_exposure: High: requires unphysiological non-conversational T >= 50 to clear dual scalar thresholds.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.numerical_stability: Extremely high: non-negative scalar, zero risk of division by zero or singularity.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.interpretability: Low: a single scalar conflates orthogonal emotional dimensions (e.g. positive joy vs threatening fear).
rq5_representation_hierarchy.computational_cost: Negligible O(1): Euclidean norm of a 3-element vector (~0.1 microseconds).
rq5_representation_hierarchy.relation_to_active_inference: Canonical S4 implementation baseline: represents unadapted generative prediction error when A=I, b=0.

rq5_representation_hierarchy.name: Full Displacement Vector
rq5_representation_hierarchy.formulation: Delta_p = [Delta P, Delta A, Delta D] = p_T - p_0
rq5_representation_hierarchy.tier_separability: Massive separation across primary conversational T <= 25. At T=12: Pleasure separates Med from High with Cohen's d = -3.85 (Delta_HM = -0.1983, CI95 [-0.218, -0.178]); Arousal separates Med from High with Cohen's d = +3.32 (Delta_HM = +0.1789, CI95 [+0.158, +0.200]).
rq5_representation_hierarchy.information_retained: 100% of limbic kinematic trajectory displacement retained; lossless 3D representation.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.collapse_behavior: Zero isotropic collapse: completely uncouples orthogonal affective axes.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.robustness_across_T: Extremely robust: component divergence manifests as early as T=2 and stabilizes across all T.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.sensitivity_to_baseline: High: explicitly measures displacement from resting baseline p_0.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.sensitivity_to_exposure: Low: strong statistical effect sizes (d > 2.0) present at conversational T=4 to T=12.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.numerical_stability: Extremely high: bounded strictly within [-2.0, 2.0]^3 by PAD state invariants.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.interpretability: Extremely high: directly reflects psychological PAD space (Pleasure, Arousal, Dominance).
rq5_representation_hierarchy.computational_cost: Negligible O(1): element-wise vector subtraction (~0.1 microseconds).
rq5_representation_hierarchy.relation_to_active_inference: Directly maps to the unadapted prediction error vector delta = p_pred - q before L2 scalarization.

rq5_representation_hierarchy.name: Magnitude + Direction
rq5_representation_hierarchy.tier_separability: Decouples cognitive urgency/intensity (magnitude) from affective quality/tone (direction). Tiers clearly separated by direction even when magnitudes collide.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.information_retained: Full 3D displacement information retained, decomposed into polar coordinates.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.collapse_behavior: Robust against collapse: direction completely resolves scalar collisions by exposing 40-100 degree angles.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.robustness_across_T: High: directional unit vectors are stable from T=4 through T=25.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.sensitivity_to_baseline: High: centered at resting baseline p_0.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.sensitivity_to_exposure: Moderate: direction becomes stable after initial non-zero displacement (T >= 2).
rq5_representation_hierarchy.numerical_stability: Moderate: requires epsilon protection against division by zero at ||Delta_p|| -> 0.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.interpretability: High: polar decomposition mirrors intuitive intensity vs valence/arousal direction.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.computational_cost: Minimal O(1): vector norm + element-wise division (~0.2 microseconds).
rq5_representation_hierarchy.relation_to_active_inference: Provides precision-separable representation: magnitude sets cognitive effort; direction guides somatic routing.

rq5_representation_hierarchy.name: Residual Magnitude + Direction
rq5_representation_hierarchy.tier_separability: Maintains directional uncoupling relative to generative expectation. Identical to M2 when beliefs are unadapted, diverging cleanly as expectations adapt.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.information_retained: Full prediction residual information decomposed into magnitude and direction of expectation violation.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.collapse_behavior: Robust against collapse: directional component preserves nature of expectation failure.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.robustness_across_T: High: tracks generative belief evolution across varying exposure durations.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.sensitivity_to_baseline: Low to Moderate: anchored to generative expectation A p_0 + b rather than static baseline p_0.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.sensitivity_to_exposure: Moderate: dependent on both ODE integration time and belief adaptation state.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.interpretability: Moderate: measures directional deviation from prior expectation rather than absolute limbic state.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.computational_cost: Low O(1): matrix-vector multiply + vector norm (~0.3 microseconds).
rq5_representation_hierarchy.relation_to_active_inference: Directly embodies Active Inference: represents generative surprise decomposed into magnitude and epistemic direction.

rq5_representation_hierarchy.name: Full Prediction Residual Vector
rq5_representation_hierarchy.formulation: r_T = [rP, rA, rD] = p_T - (A p_0 + b)
rq5_representation_hierarchy.tier_separability: High: preserves component-wise prediction failures. Under unadapted prior, identically matches M1 separation. Under adapted beliefs, selectively emphasizes unexpected dimensional transitions.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.information_retained: 100% of epistemic expectation violation retained across all 3 PAD dimensions.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.collapse_behavior: Zero isotropic collapse: independent component residuals cannot mask one another.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.robustness_across_T: High across conversational T; continuously aligned with generative transition model.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.sensitivity_to_baseline: Low: conditioned on dynamic expectation A p_0 + b.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.sensitivity_to_exposure: Moderate: reflects cumulative divergence between continuous ODE and linear transition model.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.numerical_stability: High: bounded linear transformation and subtraction; zero singularities.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.interpretability: High for Active Inference diagnostics; requires understanding generative prior.
rq5_representation_hierarchy.computational_cost: Low O(1): 3x3 matrix-vector multiplication and subtraction (~0.2 microseconds).
rq5_representation_hierarchy.relation_to_active_inference: Exact un-scalarized prediction error vector delta in ActiveInferenceEngine before Euclidean norm is applied.

evidence_synthesis.decision_state: State B — Direction/Component Information Demonstrably Omitted Under Scalar S
evidence_synthesis.rationale: Empirical evidence demonstrates that canonical scalar S routinely collapses orthogonal affective states into identical scalar distances (|diff_S| <= 0.02). Magnitude-controlled analysis reveals that within S-matched strata, directional angles (48-63 deg) and component divergences (Pleasure Cohen's d ~ -3.85, Arousal Cohen's d ~ +3.32) consistently distinguish Medium from High probes. Furthermore, under unadapted beliefs, prediction residual r_T degenerates mathematically to displacement Delta_p, proving that canonical S measures displacement rather than directional prediction error.

competing_interpretations_assessment.M_S_scalar_sufficiency: Weakened under the current dynamical regime and frozen G1 stimulus set: canonical S fails to distinguish Medium from High at all conversational T <= 25, not because the limbic system fails to differentiate them, but because scalar Euclidean projection collapses orthogonal states.
competing_interpretations_assessment.M_V_vector_information_requirement: Strongly supported as an empirical finding under frozen G1: direction and individual PAD components retain strong affective separation (Cohen's d > 3.0) that is completely discarded by scalar S.
